newsitem.title: USA: Brown Brothers says cuts U.S. bond market outlook.
newsitem.headline: Brown Brothers says cuts U.S. bond market outlook.

text.p: Wall Street investment firm Brown Brothers Harriman said Friday it had downgraded its near-term outlook on the U.S. bond market to neutral from bullish.
"The catalyst was (Federal Reserve Chairman Alan) Greenspan's speech" on Wednesday, said Eugene Mintz, deputy manager and financial markets analyst at Brown Brothers.
"But with (poor) technical factors the past couple weeks, there wasn't much to go on the upside for bond prices," he added.
